details: The early native BudgetLatex preflight rejects inherited field projections from a structure named Input. Rename only the new public input structure to Public and its parent projection to toPublic; formulas, fields, mathematical graph, source assumptions, method and proofs stay unchanged. No new statement files or filled proofs have been accepted. The supported controller API requires graph restart to revise a planned declaration name; retain historical reviews and revalidate the same graph plus renamed plan.
